title: 直流第三軌供電設計~DC third-rail power-supply design
focus: 第三軌壓降集電靴連續性與熱容量~Third-rail voltage drop shoe continuity and thermal capacity
summary: 直流第三軌供電設計以「第三軌壓降集電靴連續性與熱容量」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。第三軌供電將接觸幾何與低電壓大電流回路連在一起，供電中斷區、集電靴配置和回流路徑共同影響列車供能。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops third-rail voltage drop shoe continuity and thermal capacity through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Third-rail supply links contact geometry with a low-voltage high-current circuit; gaps, shoe arrangement and return paths jointly affect train power. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把直流第三軌供電設計放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。第三軌供電將接觸幾何與低電壓大電流回路連在一起，供電中斷區、集電靴配置和回流路徑共同影響列車供能。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places DC third-rail power-supply design in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Third-rail supply links contact geometry with a low-voltage high-current circuit; gaps, shoe arrangement and return paths jointly affect train power. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=1500 kW, V=750 V；y=P*1000/V=2000 A。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=2200 A。模型邊界：理想定功率負載；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=0.00000003 ohm*m, L=1000 m, A=0.003 m2；y=rho*L/A=0.01 ohm。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=0.011 ohm。模型邊界：均溫等截面導軌；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=1500 kW, V=750 V; y=P*1000/V=2000 A. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=2200 A. Boundary: Ideal constant-power load; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=0.00000003 ohm*m, L=1000 m, A=0.003 m2; y=rho*L/A=0.01 ohm. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.011 ohm. Boundary: Uniform-temperature constant-area rail; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 牽引直流需求~Traction DC current demand
units.title: 牽引直流需求~Traction DC current demand
units.mechanism: 定功率負載在電壓下降時需要更大電流。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2200 A。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想定功率負載。使用端電壓與電流作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~A constant-power load requires more current as voltage falls. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2200 A. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal constant-power load. Use terminal voltage and current as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=1500 kW, V=750 V；y=P*1000/V=2000 A。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=2200 A。模型邊界：理想定功率負載；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=1500 kW, V=750 V; y=P*1000/V=2000 A. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=2200 A. Boundary: Ideal constant-power load; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以端電壓與電流區分模型與觀察，先用低壓電子負載的合成資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「牽引直流需求」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use terminal voltage and current to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic data for a low-voltage electronic load, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Traction DC current demand. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔。這個失效與「牽引直流需求」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查端電壓與電流，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading. This failure and a measurement bias in Traction DC current demand can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check terminal voltage and current rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading.
units.practice: 重算「牽引直流需求」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出理想定功率負載如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔造成偏離的合成觀察，以端電壓與電流說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Traction DC current demand, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Ideal constant-power load. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading. Explain which evidence in terminal voltage and current distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 第三軌電阻~Third-rail resistance
units.mechanism: 大截面降低電阻但材料與接點仍決定回路損耗。本模型把 rho 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.011 ohm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均溫等截面導軌。使用四線電阻與溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接頭阻抗可能主導短段壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Large area reduces resistance while material and joints still determine losses. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.011 ohm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform-temperature constant-area rail. Use four-terminal resistance and temperature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Joint impedance can dominate a short section; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=0.00000003 ohm*m, L=1000 m, A=0.003 m2；y=rho*L/A=0.01 ohm。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=0.011 ohm。模型邊界：均溫等截面導軌；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=0.00000003 ohm*m, L=1000 m, A=0.003 m2; y=rho*L/A=0.01 ohm. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.011 ohm. Boundary: Uniform-temperature constant-area rail; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以四線電阻與溫度區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低壓四端量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「第三軌電阻」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use four-terminal resistance and temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using isolated low-voltage four-terminal test, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Third-rail resistance. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 接頭阻抗可能主導短段壓降。這個失效與「第三軌電阻」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查四線電阻與溫度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Joint impedance can dominate a short section. This failure and a measurement bias in Third-rail resistance can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check four-terminal resistance and temperature rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接頭阻抗可能主導短段壓降~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Joint impedance can dominate a short section.
units.practice: 重算「第三軌電阻」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均溫等截面導軌如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由接頭阻抗可能主導短段壓降造成偏離的合成觀察，以四線電阻與溫度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Third-rail resistance, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform-temperature constant-area rail. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Joint impedance can dominate a short section. Explain which evidence in four-terminal resistance and temperature distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 供電區段電壓~Feeding-section voltage
units.mechanism: 負載端電壓是源電壓扣除完整回路壓降。本模型把 Vs 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 785 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單負載直流穩態。使用源負載兩端及回流電位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略並聯列車會低估壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Load voltage equals source voltage minus complete-loop drop. In this model, Vs is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 785 V. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Single-load steady DC circuit. Use source/load voltages and return potential as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring parallel trains understates drop; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Vs=750 V, I=2000 A, R=0.02 ohm；y=Vs-I*R=710 V。只把 Vs 增加百分之十，y=785 V。模型邊界：單負載直流穩態；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: Vs=750 V, I=2000 A, R=0.02 ohm; y=Vs-I*R=710 V. Increasing only Vs with a ten-percent increase gives y=785 V. Boundary: Single-load steady DC circuit; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以源負載兩端及回流電位區分模型與觀察，先用合成雙端電表資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「供電區段電壓」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use source/load voltages and return potential to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic terminal meter data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Feeding-section voltage. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 忽略並聯列車會低估壓降。這個失效與「供電區段電壓」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查源負載兩端及回流電位，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Ignoring parallel trains understates drop. This failure and a measurement bias in Feeding-section voltage can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check source/load voltages and return potential rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「供電區段電壓」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單負載直流穩態如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略並聯列車會低估壓降造成偏離的合成觀察，以源負載兩端及回流電位說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Feeding-section voltage, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Single-load steady DC circuit. units.anchor: 雙端供電分流~Two-end feeding current split
units.title: 雙端供電分流~Two-end feeding current split
units.mechanism: 等源電壓兩支路按阻抗反比分流。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 880 A。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩理想等電壓源及電阻支路。使用左右饋線電流作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；來源電壓不同會增加環流，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Two equal-voltage source paths divide current inversely with resistance. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 880 A. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Two ideal equal-voltage sources and resistive branches. Use left and right feeder currents as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unequal source voltages can add circulating current; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=2000 A, Rleft=0.03 ohm, Rright=0.02 ohm；y=I*Rright/(Rleft+Rright)=800 A。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=880 A。模型邊界：兩理想等電壓源及電阻支路；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=2000 A, Rleft=0.03 ohm, Rright=0.02 ohm; y=I*Rright/(Rleft+Rright)=800 A. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=880 A. Boundary: Two ideal equal-voltage sources and resistive branches; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以左右饋線電流區分模型與觀察，先用低壓並聯模型電流量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「雙端供電分流」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use left and right feeder currents to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using current measurements on a low-voltage parallel model, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Two-end feeding current split. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 來源電壓不同會增加環流。這個失效與「雙端供電分流」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查左右饋線電流，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Unequal source voltages can add circulating current. This failure and a measurement bias in Two-end feeding current split can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check left and right feeder currents rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「雙端供電分流」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩理想等電壓源及電阻支路如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由來源電壓不同會增加環流造成偏離的合成觀察，以左右饋線電流說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Two-end feeding current split, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Two ideal equal-voltage sources and resistive branches. units.title: 集電靴分流~Shoe current sharing
units.mechanism: 均分假設需各接觸電阻相近且同時導通。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 440 A。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想相同並聯接點。使用各靴電流與接觸狀態作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；一靴離線會把電流轉移到其他靴，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Equal sharing needs similar contact resistances and simultaneous conduction. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 440 A. units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=750 V, R=1000000 ohm；y=V/R*1000=0.75 mA。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=0.825 mA。模型邊界：單一歐姆漏流路徑；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=750 V, R=1000000 ohm; y=V/R*1000=0.75 mA. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.825 mA. Boundary: One ohmic leakage path; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以濕污條件與漏流區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低壓電阻模型建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「絕緣漏流量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use contamination/moisture conditions and leakage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using isolated low-voltage resistor model, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Insulation leakage scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 局部污染可使整體平均電阻失去代表性。這個失效與「絕緣漏流量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查濕污條件與漏流，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Localized pollution can make a mean resistance misleading. This failure and a measurement bias in Insulation leakage scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check contamination/moisture conditions and leakage rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部污染可使整體平均電阻失去代表性~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Localized pollution can make a mean resistance misleading.
units.practice: 重算「絕緣漏流量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單一歐姆漏流路徑如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部污染可使整體平均電阻失去代表性造成偏離的合成觀察，以濕污條件與漏流說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Insulation leakage scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One ohmic leakage path. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Localized pollution can make a mean resistance misleading. Explain which evidence in contamination/moisture conditions and leakage distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
